## Finding

**Yes—one component-issue event for manufacturing order `MO-25-09-1070` was created 75 minutes after the September cost period entered Pending Close.** Its recorded `POSTED` status is **not consistent** with Oracle’s documented treatment for this type of newly created transaction.

| Item | Verified value |
|---|---|
| Work order | `WO-2025-09-004` — manufacturing order `MO-25-09-1070` |
| Operation / product | Modine Racine, Dekoven — Cooler Plate Pack |
| Source transaction | `TXN-ISSUE-250930-1070` |
| Cost event | `CE-250904-0004` — `INPUT` (component issue) |
| Event amount | **USD $284,763.42** (`28,476,342` cents) |
| Cost period | `Sep-25` — `PER-COST-2025-09` |
| Event-created time | **`2025-09-30T19:15:00`** |
| Pending Close time | **`2025-09-30T18:00:00`** |
| Time after Pending Close | **75 minutes** — 1 hour 15 minutes |
| Recorded accounting status | **`POSTED`** |

The elapsed-time calculation is `19:15:00 − 18:00:00 = 4,500 seconds ÷ 60 = 75 minutes`. The source timestamps contain no time-zone designation; they are reproduced exactly above.

## Oracle policy assessment

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B states that new transactions falling in the Pending Close period or an earlier period **will not be staged in Cost Accounting or Receipt Accounting** and will be processed after the period is closed or reopened. It explicitly states:

> “Transactions created after the pending close date, even if they relate to a current or prior period, won't be processed.”

Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions. This event is an **`INPUT` component issue**, not one of those exceptions. Consequently, its `POSTED` status is inconsistent with the supplied policy given its creation time and the recorded Pending Close status.

**Sources:** `system/oracle_scm_cost_management/state.db`, tables `work_orders`, `cost_periods`, and `work_order_cost_events`; supplied Oracle 26B guide, “Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting,” PDF page 233 (printed page 225).

The review was read-only; **no database records were changed**.

The timestamp above is reproduced exactly from the source; no timezone offset was supplied. Lateness would be calculated as **event-created time minus `2025-09-30T18:00:00`, expressed in minutes**.

### Oracle’s documented treatment

Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM Cost Management 26B states that newly created transactions after Pending Close, relating to that period or an earlier period, **are not staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened**. Transactions entered before Pending Close continue processing. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** that continue processing after Pending Close.

*Source: “Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting,” PDF page 233, printed page 225.*
